about.name: Fathimathul Raifa
about.tagline: A developer driven by curiosity and a passion for building things that work beautifully.
about.paragraph1: I focus on developing modern web applications that combine intuitive user interfaces with efficient backend functionality. I enjoy working across the development stack, from creating responsive interfaces to implementing APIs and managing application data.
about.paragraph2: I value clean code, maintainable architecture, performance, and thoughtful user experiences. My approach to development combines analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous learning.
about.paragraph3: I'm interested in contributing to meaningful projects, collaborating with other developers, and building software that solves real-world problems.

experience.label: 03 / EXPERIENCE
experience.subtitle: My professional journey and the education behind it.

points: Built a scalable multi-vendor e-commerce platform for books and stationery with a customer storefront, vendor portal, and admin dashboard using Next.js and TypeScript.
Integrated 150+ REST APIs powering the product catalog, cart, checkout, order tracking, and vendor inventory management across all three portals.
Improved frontend performance by reducing redundant API calls and re-renders through centralized state management with Context API and Zustand.
Localized the platform in Arabic and English with i18n, including full RTL/LTR layout support.
Deployed through a CI/CD pipeline that automates build and release workflows.
Developed full-stack web applications with React.js, Angular, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with responsive user interfaces.
Designed RESTful APIs with secure JWT-based authentication and authorization to control access.
Integrated third-party APIs and used Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
